name: lumaflow-studio
description: Plataforma full-stack de gestion del flujo de trabajo para fotografos.

scripts.start:frontend: cd frontend && npm run dev -- --host localhost --port 5173
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.format: npm run format:frontend && npm run format:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
